question: Deficiency of Vitamin C causes:
solution:
The correct answer is__** scurvy.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vitamin C** deficiency leads to the disease known as **scurvy**.
 
• Scurvy is characterized by symptoms such as **fatigue, weakness, swollen gums, and joint pain**.
 
• This deficiency occurs due to insufficient intake of **fruits and vegetables, particularly citrus fruits.**
 
• Vitamin C is essential for **the synthesis of collagen,** an important protein for skin, cartilage, and bones.
 
• Scurvy can be prevented and treated effectively with vitamin C supplementation or increased dietary intake of vitamin C-rich foods.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vitamin C**: Also known as ascorbic acid, it is a water-soluble vitamin that plays a vital role in many bodily functions, including antioxidant protection and immune function.
 
• **Symptoms of Scurvy**:
 
 
• **Fatigue and Weakness**: General feeling of tiredness and lack of energy.
 
• **Swollen Gums**: Gums may become soft, swollen, and bleed easily.
 
• **Joint Pain**: Painful joints due to weakened connective tissue.
 
• **Skin Issues**: Bruising and poor wound healing may occur.
 
 
 
• **Sources of Vitamin C**:
 
 
• Citrus fruits (oranges, lemons, grapefruits)
 
• Berries (strawberries, blueberries)
 
• Vegetables (bell peppers, broccoli, Brussels sprouts)
 
• Leafy greens (spinach, kale)
 
 
 
• **Other Deficiencies**:
 
 
• **Goiter**: Caused by iodine deficiency, leading to thyroid gland enlargement.
 
• **Loss of Vision**: Often linked to vitamin A deficiency, leading to conditions like night blindness.
 
• **Beriberi**: Caused by thiamine (vitamin B1) deficiency, affecting the cardiovascular and nervous systems.
 
 
 
• **Historical Context**: Scurvy was historically prevalent among sailors during long sea voyages when fresh produce was scarce, leading to significant health issues.
